explication: yt-dlp is a command-line audio/video downloader. A user supplies URLs or searches; the CLI parses configuration, YoutubeDL dispatches site extractors, extracts metadata and formats, selects downloads, retrieves media through protocol/fragment downloaders, then runs postprocessors and writes output files. The README also documents cookies, playlists, subtitles, metadata editing, caching, and external FFmpeg processing. The tree and excerpts support the central orchestration and representative search, networking, fragment, and metadata paths; some peripheral wiring is inferred only from documented capabilities.
